newsitem.title: UK: Tarmac gains after positive statement.
newsitem.headline: Tarmac gains after positive statement.

text.p: Shares in Tarmac Plc rose in early trading on Tuesday after the building materials and construction company posted better-than-expected results coupled with an upbeat trading statement.
The stock was up 8p at 112 by 0730 GMT in volume of 675,594 shares, its highest since July last year.
"The figures were very good, at the top end of expectations," said one senior dealer.
The company said profits before tax and exceptional items rose to 75.5 million stg, compared with analyst expectations of around 65.5 million stg, according to the Estimate Directory.
"The outlook for 1997 and beyond is much improved," said Chairman Neville Simms.

"The year has started well in our UK markets. Across the group we are beginning to enjoy the benefits of the additional growth opportunities and strong foundation created in 1996, at home and overseas."
